## Geryoneo (CR 10)

This bronze-skinned giant has three bodies from the waist up, with three heads and six arms wielding weapons and shields, but only one pelvis and a single pair of thick, muscular legs.  

**XP** 9,600  
LE Large humanoid (giant)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** all-round vision, low-light vision; Perception +22  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 11, flat-footed 22 (+6 armor, +2 Dex, +6 natural, +1 shield, -1 size)  
**hp** 127 (15d8+60)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +9, **Will** +9  
**Defensive Abilities** threefold body, threefold mind  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** +1 bronze shortsword +16/+11/+6 (1d8+7/19-20), +1 club +16 (1d8+7), +1 bronze-tipped shortspear +16 (1d8+7), 2 light bronze shields +15 (1d4+6)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rock throwing (120 ft.), threefold presence  


**Statistics**


**Str** 23, **Dex** 15, **Con** 18, **Int** 10, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +11; **CMB** +18; **CMD** 30 (38 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Fortified Armor Training, Lightning Reflexes, Martial Weapon Proficiency (light shield, shortsword), Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (club, shortspear, shortsword)  
**Skills** Intimidate +17, Perception +22  
**Languages** Common, Giant, Infernal  


**Special Abilities**



**Six-Armed (Ex)** A geryoneo usually comes into battle wielding three different one-handed weapons and three light bronze shields. It also will wear three bronze breastplates. Only one breastplate and shield at a time provides a bonus on the geryoneo’s armor class, but this bonus is not lost unless all three coordinated pieces are destroyed or disarmed. Since each head controls a torso and a pair of arms, all of the geryoneo’s three weapon attacks are considered primary attacks, but it attacks only once in a round with each one of its weapons, while using two shields to perform shield bashes as off-hand attacks.  

**Threefold Body (Ex)** A geryoneo’s vital organs and senses are spread across all three of its linked bodies. An effect that would cause it to become blinded or deafened instead affects only one of its bodies, unless it affects an area or targets each body as a separate creature. If one body is blinded or deafened, the geryoneo suffers no ill effects. If two bodies are blinded or deafened, it loses its all-around vision and is dazzled. A geryoneo is blinded or deafened only if all three bodies are blinded or deafened. It likewise has a 75% chance to ignore critical hits, sneak attack damage, and similar precision-based damage.  

**Threefold Mind (Ex)** A geryoneo’s heads think independently from each other, even if they are mentally connected and the giant has one will only. Every mind-affecting effect targeted at the geryoneo only affects one of its heads if the giant fails its saving throw. The torso and arms controlled by the affected head will stop fighting, but there will be no other effect unless all three the geryoneo’s heads fail their saving throw against the same mind-affecting spell or effect.  

**Threefold Presence (Su)** Once per day, a geryoneo can split its three bodies, fighting as three separate individuals at the same time. This functions as the threefold form spell, except for the following: the three bodies appear the same age; each body only has one head, two arms, and two legs; and the equipment worn by the giant is split between the bodies rather than duplicated.
